# Sam Brown

SamBrown
**Samuel Brown**is a former designer who interned at Hot Wheels in 2004. After his internship at Hot Wheels, he moved to Adidas; he currently works at Riot Games as a concept artist, where he has worked since 2021. Prior to his move to Riot Games he worked at 343 Industries, also as a concept artist.
